moods.label: I want to be comforted
moods.line: Warm, kind books that feel like a hug.

books.title: The House in the Cerulean Sea
books.author: TJ Klune
books.reason: Found family on a magical island, and the kindest book I know.

books.title: Legends & Lattes
books.author: Travis Baldree
books.reason: Nothing terrible happens and there is always coffee. That's the point.

books.title: Howl's Moving Castle
books.author: Diana Wynne Jones
books.reason: A funny, cosy fairy tale that feels like sitting by a warm fire.

moods.label: I want my mind blown
moods.line: Big ideas and worlds you won't stop thinking about.

books.title: Klara and the Sun
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.reason: A story about love and loneliness, seen through the eyes of a machine.

books.title: The Midnight Library
books.author: Matt Haig
books.reason: Every life you didn't live, waiting on a library shelf. It stays with you.

books.title: The Night Circus
books.author: Erin Morgenstern
books.reason: A world so vivid you'll swear you have walked through it.

moods.label: Something I can read in one sitting
moods.line: Short enough to finish with one pot of tea.

books.title: Tuesdays with Morrie
books.author: Mitch Albom
books.reason: Short, gentle and full of wisdom. An evening well spent.

books.title: The Remains of the Day
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.reason: A slim, quiet novel you'll finish in one go and think about for weeks.

books.title: The Book Thief
books.author: Markus Zusak
books.reason: Death as the narrator and a girl who loves words. Bring tissues.

books.title: A Man Called Ove
books.author: Fredrik Backman
books.reason: It starts out funny and ends with you sobbing into your tea.

books.title: Tuesdays with Morrie
books.author: Mitch Albom
books.reason: A last lesson from a beloved teacher. Impossible not to cry.

moods.line: Page-turners you won't be able to put down.

books.title: The Night Circus
books.author: Erin Morgenstern
books.reason: One more chapter, then another, and suddenly it's 2am.

books.title: Anxious People
books.author: Fredrik Backman
books.reason: Twists and surprises that keep you turning the pages.

books.title: The Midnight Library
books.author: Matt Haig
